verdict.rationale: Deepgram is a cloud speech API, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask, but the evidence pack never documents a control that stops customer data from being used for model training. The self-hosted/in-VPC deployment option (deepgram-docs-15) and optional PII redaction (deepgram-docs-13) are related but different features. They are not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
